name: Whisper tiny
notes: ENCODER-DECODER. Smallest Whisper variant. ENCODER: 4 layers, d_model 384, 6 heads, encoder_ffn_dim 1536, gelu, num_mel_bins 80, max_source_positions 1500. DECODER: 4 layers, 6 heads, decoder_ffn_dim 1536, max_target_positions 448. KV CACHE: decoder self-attention 4 * 6 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 30,720 B/token = 30 KiB/token. Cross-attention over 1500 encoder frames: 4 * 6 * 64 * 1500 * 2 * 2 = 9,216,000 B = 8.8 MiB per in-flight request. The encoder is the compute-heavy part; the decoder is trivial. STREAMING: not natively supported (offline/batch model).
